comparison.objective: Separate intact ceramic media from metal washers vs grate a target mass of cheese into a dish.
comparison.physical_skill: Mobilize existing rigid particles through screen apertures while retaining parts vs stabilize a grater and repeatedly shear material with controlled pressure and safe finger clearance.
comparison.success_condition: ≥98% recovered media, all washers retained, no spill/damage, released screen vs 15–25 g grated into dish, grater retained, cheese returned, blade clearance, and 1 s stillness.
comparison.reason: Both handle many small pieces, but grating creates material by cutting; the candidate classifies intact bodies by aperture passage.
